Nina R. (sales): Heads-up: customer demo at 17:30Z, they want to run a hands-on session with ~6 engineers concurrently. Can we get a temporary capacity increase on their hosted POC key for 90 minutes?
Sam P. (solutions): Which key id? We issued two scoped keys last week. Would prefer to issue an ephemeral key tied to their demo IPs so we don't touch long-lived keys.
Nina R. (sales): It's the scoped key for 'atlas-poc' but ephemeral is fine. They can provide the source IPs.
Diego M. (infra): Current scoped key limits: 40 qps, 2500 tokens/min. Rough calc: 6 users * avg 300 tokens/req * 60 req/min = 54k tokens/min -> will exceed. Ephemeral option: we can spin a key with 120 qps and 90k tokens/min for 1.5h. Need CIDRs and approval for billing.
Nina R. (sales): CIDRs: 3.5.72.0/24 (customer office), 52.44.128.0/24 (dev box pool). Billing code: RDW-TRIAL-ATL. Requester: nina@redwood.com.
Sam P. (solutions): I'll prepare a fallback strategy: when utilization >85% switch traffic to a cheaper quantized model (redwood-mini-q) automatically instead of returning 429s. Also add graceful degradation headers so client can detect fallback.
Diego M. (infra): Good. I'll create ephemeral key with IP allowlist, set soft-throttle thresholds, and create an alert on error_rate >= 0.8%. Ticket created: SR-20260321-0993. Window: 2026-03-21T17:00:00Z to 2026-03-21T18:30:00Z.
Finance-bot: Note: Any usage beyond the uplift will be invoiced at the POC overage rate. Please confirm acceptance.
Nina R. (sales): Customer ok with charges if we keep them informed. Please post the key to #poc-secrets and DM me.
Sam P. (solutions): Example of the ephemeral issuance call I'll run (admin only):
```
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/ephemeral
Auth: Bearer $ADMIN
Body: {"project":"atlas-poc","expires_in":"90m","cidrs":["3.5.72.0/24","52.44.128.0/24"],"quota":{"qps":120,"tokens_per_min":90000}}
```
Diego M. (infra): Key issued: eph_atlas_9z8y (shared to #poc-secrets). Uplift applied. Fallback to redwood-mini-q enabled at 85% capacity. Monitoring dashboard: link://ops.redwood/atlas-poc-ephemeral (internal).
Nina R. (sales): Running a smoke test at 17:10Z to validate. Will report back here if we see throttles. :crossed_fingers:
Sam P. (solutions): If the client sees any 429s, ask them to include x-request-id from the response. That helps trace into the routing logs.
Diego M. (infra): Auto-revoke scheduled for 18:30Z and I'll keep alerts on until 19:00Z just to watch for late retries. Closing ticket when monitoring is stable.
Finance-bot: SR-20260321-0993 -> RESOLVED when uplift window ends.
